text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"And the leader crosses the finish line!
In 1st place is..."
(WOOOAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Haa, hah...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I never expected you to come this far...!
That was a great run, Dia-chan.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan too.
She's gotten way stronger than I ever imagined!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Really!? But in the Arima Kinen,
I'll aim to run even better than today!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I am not satisfied with just this level either.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I feel that I have finally managed to stand on the very same starting line as Kita-chan, McQueen-san, and Teio-san ahead of me.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
—Sounds good.
Both Kita-chan and Dia-chan too.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Those glinting eyes, burning to defeat us...
I really love that look.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: It just made me remember how I used to be.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Teio-san from... back then?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. I used to look up to the President too...
I ran in the Twinkle Series thinking that
someday, I'd surpass her."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: When I challenged Prez to a direct showdown...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: The person I looked up to turned into my rival.I was determined to beat her no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I found myself thinking, "I bet those two are feeling just like I did back then!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Even so, I haven't forgotten that fighting spirit from back then either.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
When you see running like that right before your eyes,
it just fires you up to go out and do it too.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
At the Arima Kinen, I'm going to take on
Dia-chan and Kita-chan as a challenger!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You'd better be ready!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: —Kh! Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'll face this with all my heart and focus!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (How one ought to be as a "Renowned Umamusume"...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(McQueen as the defender accepting the challenge.
Teio as the challenger taking it on.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (In that case, I...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(The Satono family's very first GⅠ victory...
A victory seized by challenging the jinx and overcoming it.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(Chasing after Kita-chan led to this race
on the grand stage of the Twinkle Series.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (The way of being that is true to myself is...!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

After a long silence,
Satono Diamond finally spoke, her face
marked with a look of fierce resolve.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I intend to keep challenging myself
from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I have constantly taken on challenges.
Such as the jinx plaguing the Satono family,
and Kita-chan.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That is why, as a 'renowned Umamusume,'
I believe continuing to take on all kinds of challenges is true to who I am.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Just as challenging McQueen-san and Teio-san
wrote a brand new page
in the Satono family's history.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I want to take on every challenge
and carve out a new history
for Satono and the entire Umamusume world.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: When I thought about that, it made me realize once more that I really want to take on overseas races.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Not to show possibilities,
but as my own desire.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I want to win a prestigious overseas race and etch the Satono name into Umamusume history.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
And pave the way for a new chapter in history
for both House Satono and the world of Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I believe that is a way
I can contribute to the Umamusume world.
choice_data_list: So you found the answer, huh.
So you found the answer, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
How Satono Diamond should be as a "great Umamusume"...
The self I should strive to become is now set.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I shall win the Arima Kinen
and join the ranks of the legendary Umamusume!
